reply: The best candidate I scored has training NMSE 8.7e-5 (free exponents on v and t), and the earlier best of 7.06e-5 still stands as the recorded best. The data is consistent with a driving term that grows roughly linearly in t, plus t/x and 1/v-type terms, but no closed form reached the 1e-12 target.

import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    p=params
    return p[0] + p[1]*t + p[2]*t/x + p[3]*v**p[4] + p[5]/v**p[6] + p[7]*t**p[8] + p[9]*t*t/x
